{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Parse the revenue column
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Compute conversion rate over ALL customers (including refunded ones), as per the contract
# Conversion rate = proportion of converted orders (converted == 1) in the full dataset
conversion_rates_all = sales_df.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean()

# Find the segment with the highest conversion rate
highest_segment_all = conversion_rates_all.idxmax()

# Output the result
conversion_rates_all, highest_segment_all"}
